newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline up despite soft futures.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline up despite soft futures.

text.p: NWE gasoline prices were firmer again on Tuesday amid good buying again from at least two players.

Eurograde barges changed hands at $211.50 a tonne fob Rotterdam and $208.50 fob ARA, the latter barge for the second half of June. These compared with a deal as low as $204.50 on Monday for stored material.
One of the buyers on Tuesday was said still seeking Eurograde cargo material into Hamburg and dealers pegged cif bids for this some $9 a tonne above barges.
